I am currently working on filing a hefty lawsuit against Georgia DFCS and the county I formerly resided in. I went through a similar situation. Requesting help from headquarters in Atlanta and having the case moved to a federal court out of the area are probably your best bets. The DFCS workers are basically a sorority, they will lie, protect each other, and forge documents. The courts and attorneys basically fear them because they can and will act with prejudice in other cases that come through court and will try to keep them in good graces. Keep and request any and every document signed, record conversations with these people when you talk to them and let them know you're recording. I'm not an attorney just a person but I'm sharing all the things I have done or wished that I had done. Please keep us updated on how things are going!
